notes: Account profile: mid-to-large engineering org building developer tooling (code intelligence + search). Heavy focus on internal engineering productivity; goal is single search layer over mono-repo + multi-repo codebases.

Primary constraint: embedding index scale — expect ~150M vectors initially, growth to 400M+ within 12 months. Index per-file and per-symbol embeddings (avg 3 vectors/file), large binary blobs excluded.

Workload pattern: continuous ingestion + frequent re-indexing (nightly full bucket, micro-updates throughout day). Many small commits across 25k repos; need efficient incremental embedding pipeline and partial reindex APIs.

Latency / throughput targets: target 99th p95 request latency <120ms for ANN fetch + cross-encoder rerank within 250ms end-to-end for interactive dev UX. Peak QPS target ~500 (sustained during dev hours), burst to 2k for internal events.

Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (full two-stage) < $0.005 avg. Will accept higher cost for rare escalations, but baseline must be economical. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching/quant profiles).

Retrieval architecture preference: hybrid ANN index for first stage (IVF/HNSW) + cross-encoder re-ranker on top-k (k=50). Want ability to run cross-encoder on Dedicated GPU pool with autoscale. Also explore cheap rerank proxies (lightweight MLP) for low-cost fallbacks.

Model preferences: open models preferred for private deployment (Llama2 variants quantized), cross-encoder using a smaller fine-tuned bi-encoder vs full cross-attention tradeoffs. Must support INT8/4 quantization and kernel selection on A100/H100/TPU-v4 if available.

Security & compliance notes: strict SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning, mandatory audit logs for all index writes and query traces, KMS integration for key rotation. Data residency: primary EU/NA mapping — code and embeddings must stay in customer VPC for private deployment.

POC ask: 6-week proof-of-concept. Objectives: (1) demonstrate incremental reindex latency < 10s for micro-updates, (2) show end-to-end search P95 < 250ms at 500 QPS, (3) provide cost projection for 150M -> 400M vectors on Dedicated nodes.
Quote from engineering lead: 'We need interactive speed for devs — if search feels slow they switch to grep. If you can't show 100-200ms for top-k exactness with rerank we lose adoption.'
Operational concerns: retention policies (embeddings lifecycle), snapshotting for disaster recovery, ability to purge vectors per repo on request, and immutable audit trail for regulatory review.
Prior evaluation notes: tested Elastic-based vector plugin — good recall but cost/latency unpredictable under load. Tried Pinecone managed but wanted more control over reranking and model placement.

Redwood fit: likes unified API and ability to pin model versions + rollout. Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput and Private for encryption-in-flight + residency. Wants clear fallback routing to hosted smaller models to reduce cost for low-priority queries.

Technical risks called out by Seastar infra: network egress for model hosting in Dedicated vs full on-prem; compatibility with existing Kafka ingestion pipeline; throughput for cross-encoder during re-rank spikes.

POC timeline (high level): kickoff meeting (done), infra sandbox provisioned (in progress), indexing pilot (week 2-3), rerank tuning (week 3-4), load test & cost extrapolation (week 5), executive review & legal (week 6).
